contract.clock: Fixed 2027-03-28T00:30:00.125Z; the clock advances by one minute per read to catch non-frozen calculations. UTC literals were independently derived. Relative and recurring preview must match ordinary create at the same clock.
contract.private: Real CommandRuntime must defer ephemerally and PATCH only that original response. Staff, activation and guild fences remain unchanged.
contract.rendering: Preview — not scheduled; invocation channel, canonical UTC plus Discord-local timestamp, one-off or actual recurring interval; disclose later create timing/availability revalidation. Bounded body excerpts must not silently hide the tail or metadata. No fabricated ID, message link or delivery promise.
contract.effects: Clock/ID/store boundaries are recording spies; real domain validators, actual path-included handler, actual executor and captured loopback REST. Zero attempted ID/store/read/write/audit/quota/queue admission for valid or invalid preview. The create control activates the same spies. Pool is closed with no connection attempt.
contract.concurrency: Two actual handler futures join on one current-thread runtime. A response gate witnesses both completion requests received before release; no sleep-based race or return-order oracle.
contract.decoding: Preview is one optional boolean. Wrong wire type and duplicate names, including false/false, refuse privately before ID or persistence. Omitted/false keep create success and rejection-audit behavior.
contract.discovery: The actual registry publication payload advertises one optional boolean preview and detailed runtime schedule help advertises it. Builder must regenerate command reference and preserve reference_docs parity controls in the same implementation PR.
contract.limits: Store-boundary spies are not a live SQL test. Direct full-dispatch tests use a closed pool; no staging/production database, live Discord or mutable environment is used. No independent cooldown/job-queue API exists in the baseline create handler: its quota/queue boundary is put_scheduled; no claim of testing a separate service is made.
